newsitem.title: UK: Thieves dull Xmas spirit at S.Africa embassy ball.
newsitem.headline: Thieves dull Xmas spirit at S.Africa embassy ball.

text.p: Guests at a glittering Christmas charity ball at the South African embassy in London found their seasonal goodwill dented after four purses and a 20,000 pound ($33,000) necklace were reported stolen during the event.

Police said four purses and the necklace, variously described as diamond and jade, disappeared from the ball, which featured a fashion show and a charity auction in aid of South African President Nelson Mandela's Children's Fund.
"A number of handbags and other property were found to be missing from a room when the owners returned to collect them," a police spokesman said.
Reports of thefts from diplomatic functions were very unusual, the spokesman said. The police are to appeal to the hundreds of guests who attended for any information.

The London Evening Standard newspaper reported that security staff, who said they were guarding the building, "not the people in it", had refused to call the police. Guests finally summoned detectives from a nearby public telephone box. ($1=.6003 Pound)
